lines.en: Theo, we were about to leave for the mountains when the hail started, and suddenly the whole sky turned black.
lines.pt: Theo, estávamos prestes a sair para as montanhas quando o granizo começou, e de repente o céu inteiro ficou preto.

lines.en: I saw it from the kitchen. I was about to phone you when the lights went out for a moment.
lines.pt: Vi da cozinha. Eu estava prestes a telefonar para você quando a luz caiu por um instante.

lines.en: I was about to lock the front door when a piece of hail hit the windscreen. It was loud!
lines.pt: Eu estava prestes a trancar a porta da frente quando um pedaço de granizo bateu no para-brisa. Foi alto!

lines.en: Is the glass damaged? My neighbour was about to park when the same thing happened, and now he needs a new windscreen.
lines.pt: O vidro está danificado? Meu vizinho estava prestes a estacionar quando aconteceu o mesmo, e agora precisa de um para-brisa novo.

lines.en: Only a small crack. We were about to drive off anyway, so we waited inside until the storm stopped.
lines.pt: Só uma pequena rachadura. Íamos sair mesmo assim, então esperamos lá dentro até a tempestade passar.

lines.en: Sensible. When I was little, my father was about to take us camping when a storm like that arrived, and we stayed home.
lines.pt: Sensato. Quando eu era pequeno, meu pai estava prestes a nos levar acampar quando chegou uma tempestade assim, e ficamos em casa.

lines.en: I always hated it when a trip was cancelled just as we were about to set off.
lines.pt: Eu sempre odiei quando uma viagem era cancelada justo quando íamos partir.

lines.en: A bit, but we played cards by the fire, and honestly that night was better than any camping trip I remember.
lines.pt: Um pouco, mas jogamos cartas perto da lareira, e sinceramente aquela noite foi melhor que qualquer acampamento de que me lembro.

lines.en: That is the nice thing about storms. They force everybody to stop. We were about to argue, but then we laughed instead.
lines.pt: Essa é a graça das tempestades. Obrigam todo mundo a parar. Íamos discutir, mas acabamos rindo.

lines.en: Exactly. I was about to ask whether you still want to go this weekend, if the forecast improves.
lines.pt: Exato. Eu ia perguntar se você ainda quer ir neste fim de semana, se a previsão melhorar.

lines.en: Yes, definitely. We were about to book a cabin anyway, so let me check the forecast again after dinner.
lines.pt: Sim, com certeza. Íamos reservar uma cabana mesmo assim, então deixe-me ver a previsão de novo depois do jantar.

facts.label: was about to
facts.sub: Was/were about to + verbo mostra o instante logo antes de algo: I was about to phone you. Sempre use o infinitivo sem outras formas, como leave, call, park.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: I was about to leave means I was almost leaving.
We say I was about to leaving.
items.why: Use the infinitive: about to leave.

items.s: When introduces the event that interrupted.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.

extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: I was about to leave means I was almost leaving. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say I was about to leaving. → Falso (Use the infinitive: about to leave.)
When introduces the event that interrupted. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 2/2

items.s: Were about to goes with we, you and they.
Was about to is used for plans for next year.
items.why: It is used for the moment right before.

pages.title: We were about to leave when it started · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot afternoon in Denver. Tess packs a bag by the front door. Theo waits in the kitchen with a book. The mountains look clear in the distance. Then the sky starts to change. A cold wind blows.

“Theo, we were about to leave for the mountains when the hail started, and suddenly the whole sky turned black.” says Tess. “I saw it from the kitchen. I was about to phone you when the lights went out for a moment.” says Theo. “I was about to lock the front door when a piece of hail hit the windscreen. It was loud!” says Tess.
